important_notes: app_id is our learning order, not an official IBA ranking.
iba_id remains null unless a reliable official IBA numeric identifier is confirmed.
method_official currently preserves the existing IBA-based method text from v1 and should be re-audited against official IBA pages before being labeled verbatim official text.
techniques are derived search tags from method_official and are NOT an IBA official classification.
For audited recipes, method_reference_en is a precise paraphrase of the current IBA Method section; official wording remains available via official_url.
meta.audit_progress: 101/101 methods checked against current IBA official cocktail pages
v06_notes: main_method_search is a single dominant preparation-method label for teaching/search.
auxiliary_operations preserves important secondary operations such as Muddle, Float, Rinse, Top, Dry Shake, Fine/Double Strain and Rim.
primary_spirit_group collapses non-six-base-spirit values into Other for a cleaner UI.
garnish_present and garnish_categories are app filter fields derived from official garnish text.
